title: What each element needs in love
caption: Fire needs adventure, earth needs consistency, air needs conversation, water needs safety. Which one do you fall for?

beats.head: Fire needs *adventure.*
beats.sub: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius: plans with a spark, praise said out loud.

beats.head: Give fire *room* to run.
beats.sub: Jealousy dims it. Cheering it on makes it glow.

beats.head: Earth needs *consistency.*
beats.sub: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn: say it, then do it. Every time.

beats.head: Earth trusts *actions.*
beats.sub: Fixing the wobbly shelf beats a pretty speech.

beats.head: Air needs *conversation.*
beats.sub: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius: curiosity, banter, and room to think.

beats.head: Air falls for a *mind* first.
beats.sub: Ask a strange question. Then actually listen.

vis.q: What's an opinion you'd defend forever?

beats.head: Water needs *safety.*
beats.sub: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces: gentleness, loyalty, feelings taken seriously.

beats.head: Water opens up *slowly.*
beats.sub: Rush it and it closes. Wait, and it pours.

beats.head: Your chart mixes *all four.*
beats.sub: Your Moon and Venus often say more than your Sun.
